user.title: Add a Bluetooth SIG Mesh network
user.description: Create a new network, or bring in one you already have.

create.title: Create a new network
create.description: Home Assistant makes new random keys and becomes the network's provisioner. Then add factory-reset devices with Add device.

nrf_import.title: Import from nRF Mesh
nrf_import.description: In nRF Mesh, open Settings, choose Export, export everything (with the device keys) as JSON and paste the file's contents here. The devices keep their pairing: nothing is reset.

data_description.nrf_json: The export holds the network keys. Paste it here only; do not share it.

tuya_import.title: Import from Tuya BLE Mesh
tuya_import.description: Copies the keys and the device from a Tuya BLE Mesh SIG Mesh entry. The device keeps its pairing: nothing is reset.

data_description.source_entry: Only SIG Mesh entries can be imported.
data_description.name: A device from a network you already have joins that network instead.

disable_old.title: Disable the old entry?
disable_old.description: {old} and this integration would fight over the device's one Bluetooth connection. To go back later, enable {old} again and disable the new network.

device.title: Add {name}
device.description: {name} is a factory-reset Bluetooth mesh device. Home Assistant gives it a network's keys and an address of its own, then sets it up. With no network yet, a new one is made for it.

data_description.role: Automatic makes a device with dimming a light and anything else a switch.

error.not_sig: Only SIG Mesh entries can be imported.

error.nrf_bad_json: This is not an nRF Mesh JSON export.
error.nrf_bad_keys: The export's network or application key is missing or invalid.
error.nrf_key_refresh: The network is in the middle of a key refresh. Finish it in nRF Mesh, then export again.
error.nrf_no_app_key: The export has no application key for its primary network key.

error.provision_failed_remote: The device stopped answering at the {step} step ({detail}) through an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy. Try again with the device close to Home Assistant's own Bluetooth adapter.

error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong while adding the device. Check the Home Assistant log and try again.
error.already_provisioning: That device is already being added in another window.
error.cannot_save: The device's address could not be saved ({detail}), so nothing was sent to the device. Check the Home Assistant log for disk errors and try again.

abort.device_gone: This device is no longer advertising as factory-reset: it was added already, joined another network or is out of range.

abort.half_provisioned: {name} took the network's keys but did not confirm at the {step} step, so its state is unknown. Factory-reset it and add it again; its old address stays reserved.

progress.provision: Adding {name} to the network. Keep it powered and close by; this takes up to a minute.

data_description.idle_timeout: Minutes without commands before the Bluetooth connection is closed. 0 keeps it open, so changes made at the device show up at once.
data_description.publish_setup: When a device is set up, point its status publication at Home Assistant.

user.title: Add device
user.description: Factory-reset devices in Bluetooth range of Home Assistant or of an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, strongest signal first. Home Assistant gives the chosen device this network's keys and an address of its own, then sets it up.

data_description.device: A device already in a network does not show here: reset it first.
data_description.role: Automatic makes a device with dimming a light and anything else a switch.

role.title: Change device type
role.description: Show the device as a light or as a switch.

setup_again.title: Run setup again
setup_again.description: Home Assistant reads {name}'s models again and sets it up as on the first connect: application key, bindings (Health too, for Identify), status publication and colour temperature range. The device type stays. Use this after a firmware update, or for a device set up by an older version.

reset_remove.title: Reset and remove
reset_remove.description: Home Assistant tells {name} to leave the network (Config Node Reset), then deletes it here. The device forgets the network's keys and advertises as factory-reset again. Deleting the device any other way leaves it in the network.

data.remove_anyway: Delete it here even if it does not confirm

data_description.remove_anyway: For a device that is broken or gone. If it still works it keeps the network's keys: factory-reset it by hand.

abort.already_provisioning: That device is already being added in another window.

abort.device_reset: {name} left the network and was deleted.

not_connected.message: Could not reach {name}: no mesh proxy is connected.

seq_not_saved.message: Could not send to {name}: the mesh state could not be saved. Check the Home Assistant log for disk errors and try again.

no_proxy.title: {network}: no mesh proxy in range
no_proxy.description: Home Assistant has not reached any device of {network} for {minutes} minutes. Check that a device of the network is powered and within Bluetooth range of Home Assistant or of an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with active connections enabled.

keys_rejected.title: {network}: keys rejected
keys_rejected.description: Home Assistant connected to {network} but could not read anything it sent. The network was probably reset or set up again with another app. Remove the network and import it again.

confirm.title: Adopt IV index {theirs}?
confirm.description:
The mesh announced IV index {theirs}, but Home Assistant is at {ours}. Jumps of more than one step are not applied on their own, so the devices of {network} may ignore commands until Home Assistant adopts the new IV index.

Adopt it only if the network really moved on, for example after a long time switched off while the other devices kept running. The announcement was signed with the network key.

abort.beacon_gone: There is no IV index jump to adopt any more. The network is set up again or the jump was already applied.

node_unreadable.title: {network}: device data damaged
node_unreadable.description: The saved data of {names} in {network} could not be read, so these devices were skipped. Delete them from the network and import them again.
